import random
import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 30)
alphabet = "abcd"[: rng.randint(1, 4)]
if rng.random() < 0.3:
    block = "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 5)))
    s = (block * n)[:n]
else:
    s = "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(n))
lo = rng.randint(1, n)
hi = rng.randint(lo, n)
print(s)
print(lo, hi)

import random

rng = random.Random(20260926)
n = 50000
letters = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
parts = []
size = 0
while size < n:
    if size > 0 and rng.random() < 0.5:
        cur = "".join(parts)
        m = rng.randint(200, 2000)
        start = rng.randint(0, max(0, len(cur) - m))
        piece = cur[start:start + m]
    else:
        m = rng.randint(200, 2000)
        piece = "".join(rng.choice(letters[: rng.randint(2, 26)]) for _ in range(m))
    parts.append(piece)
    size += len(piece)
s = "".join(parts)[:n]
lo = rng.randint(2, 50)
hi = rng.randint(n // 2, n - 10)
print(s)
print(lo, hi)
